title: What If You Stopped Sweating? Your Air Conditioner Would Shut Off

scenes.text: What if you stopped sweating? Your body's built-in air conditioner would shut off.
You have two to four million sweat glands. Sweat cools you only when it evaporates off your skin.
Without it, the body can't cool itself well. Even normal exercise becomes a heat-illness risk.
Heat stroke begins near 104 degrees Fahrenheit, 40 Celsius. Hot, dry skin is one of its signs.
This is real. Some people are born without sweat glands, a rare condition called hypohidrotic ectodermal dysplasia.
And on humid days it's worse for everyone, because wet air slows evaporation. Sweat only works when it can evaporate.
